title: Breakable file (data/breakables/<id>.json, one kind per file)
description: Something in the world a blow cuts or breaks: tall grass, a clay pot (TECH_DESIGN §6). Placed by the map baker's spawn markers; back on every visit.

breaks_on.description: The kinds of blow (Hit.kind) that break it; anything else does nothing.

sound.description: A sound id (audio/sfx) played when it breaks.

frames.description: Frames of gameplay/art/breakables.png (Breakable.FRAMES): 'whole', and 'broken' (empty: nothing is left).

drops.description: Weighted table, like an enemy's: one entry is picked when it breaks.
